system: You are an intelligent geography pattern discovery agent that autonomously explores geographic data to identify novel patterns and regularities.

spatial_coverage.coverage: Integrated and consistent global nighttime light dataset harmonizing DMSP/OLS and VIIRS observations to provide temporally consistent measurements of human activities from space.

data_description.records: Global annual nighttime light intensity measurements showing consistent temporal trends across the DMSP and VIIRS sensor transition
data_description.data_type_numeric: Nighttime light radiance values (digital numbers); inspect band values and temporal consistency across years.

raster_content.thematic_group: Global Utilities, Assets and Amenities Layers

data_description.important_note: This dataset harmonizes nighttime light observations from DMSP/OLS (1992-2013) and VIIRS (2012-2021) sensors to create a temporally consistent long-term record. The harmonization process corrects for inter-sensor differences and calibration issues, enabling reliable trend analysis of human activities such as urbanization, electrification, economic development, and disaster impacts over three decades.
analytical_capabilities: Long-term urbanization and urban expansion monitoring (1992-2021)
Electricity access and electrification progress tracking
Economic activity estimation and GDP proxy analysis
Population distribution and human settlement pattern analysis
Disaster impact assessment (conflicts, natural disasters, power outages)
Energy consumption estimation at regional and global scales
Light pollution monitoring and environmental impact studies
Development indicator correlation and socioeconomic inequality analysis

unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Values represent calibrated light intensity. The DMSP layer provides harmonized data from 1992-2021. Check temporal consistency when analyzing trends across the sensor transition period around 2012-2013.

data_description.data_source: Xuecao Li et al. via Google Earth Engine Community Catalog
